name: com.classicspins.cheats
description: A drop-in tester cheat menu: a game registers buttons, number fields, toggles and read-outs; the package draws the panel (uGUI, built in code, no prefab) and an in-game log viewer. Available in the Editor, in development builds, and in any build with the CS_CHEATS define. No dependency on PrototypeFramework.
